planets.name: Kepler-68 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-68 with a 9.61-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-68 c was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-68. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
